exposure: duration of interval between cesarean delivery and subsequent pregnancy
uterine scar vs no uterine scar
number of prior cesarean deliveries (1, 2, 3, or non-cesarean uterine scar)
duration of interval between cesarean delivery and subsequent pregnancy (<2 years, 2-5 years, ≥5 years)
cohort: Singleton pregnant women who delivered at West China Second University Hospital between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2021
finding: Singleton pregnancies with uterine scars, particularly those with multiple prior cesarean deliveries, were associated with higher rates of adverse perinatal outcomes.
